title: User Authentication Success
description: Verify login is successful with correct credentials and two-factor authentication.

steps.description: Navigate to login page.
Input valid username/email and password.
Submit login form.
Complete two-factor authentication using valid code.
Verify that user is successfully logged in and redirected to the appropriate dashboard based on role.

title: User Authentication Failure
description: Verify login fails with incorrect credentials or invalid two-factor authentication code.

steps.description: Navigate to login page.
Input invalid username/email or password.
Submit login form.
Verify error message is displayed indicating invalid credentials.
Attempt two-factor authentication with invalid code.
Verify two-factor authentication error message is shown and access is denied.

title: Patient Unique Identifier Validation
description: Verify system enforces unique patient identifiers and prevents duplicates.

steps.description: Create a new patient record with a unique identifier.
Verify patient is successfully created.
Attempt to create another patient record using the same unique identifier.
Verify system rejects duplicate patient identifier and displays appropriate error message.

title: Schedule Appointment - Valid Scenario
description: Verify scheduling an appointment is successful when no conflicts exist and recurrence rules apply.

steps.description: Navigate to scheduling page.
Select a patient and available physiotherapist.
Set appointment date and time without conflicts.
Enable recurrence with valid pattern (e.g., weekly for 4 weeks).
Confirm appointment scheduling.
Verify appointment is saved with correct recurrence instances and appears on all calendar views.

title: Schedule Appointment - Conflict Prevention
description: Verify system prevents scheduling overlapping appointments for same therapist or patient.

steps.description: Attempt to schedule a new appointment for a therapist during a time slot already booked.
Verify system detects conflict and prevents appointment creation with clear notification.
Attempt to schedule a new appointment for a patient during an overlapping time slot.
Verify system prevents double booking and prompts appropriate error.

title: Clinical Documentation Auto-Save and Version History
description: Verify that SOAP notes auto-save correctly and version history is maintained for clinical documentation.

steps.description: Open an existing patient's clinical documentation SOAP note.
Make changes to the note content.
Verify that changes auto-save without manual intervention.
Access version history of the SOAP note.
Verify that previous versions are listed and accessible for restore.
Restore a previous version of the SOAP note.
Verify the restored version replaces current note content.

title: AI Assistant - Automatic Report Accuracy
description: Validate AI-generated clinical reports achieve at least 95% accuracy and suggest valid treatment protocols.

steps.description: Open AI Assistant interface and input a patient case summary.
Request automatic clinical report generation.
Verify generated report contains relevant and accurate clinical information matching input data with at least 95% correctness.
Request treatment protocol suggestions.
Verify AI suggests treatment protocols that align with patient condition and clinical guidelines.

title: Patient Portal Secure Access and Data Integrity
description: Ensure patient portal requires secure authentication and displays accurate personal data, exercise tracking, and appointment management.

steps.description: Login to patient portal with valid credentials.
Verify login success and secure session is established.
Navigate through patient personal information, exercise tracking, and appointment management sections.
Verify data shown matches backend records and is up to date.
Attempt to access portal data with invalid or expired session.
Verify access is denied and user is redirected to login.

title: Financial Transactions Multi-payment Integration
description: Test that the financial system correctly processes payments using multiple payment methods and accurately tracks transactions.

steps.description: Initiate a payment using credit card.
Verify payment is accepted and transaction recorded.
Initiate a payment using bank transfer.
Verify payment is accepted and transaction details are accurate.
Initiate a payment using a combination of payment methods for one invoice.
Verify combined payment is processed and transaction records reflect all parts.
Review financial reports for payment accuracy.
Verify all payments appear correctly in reports.

title: Operational Dashboard Load Time and Data Accuracy
description: Verify executive dashboards load within 2 seconds on 3G connection and display accurate operational, clinical, and financial metrics.

steps.description: Simulate 3G network conditions on a mobile device.
Login as administrator and open main dashboard page.
Verify page loads fully within 2 seconds.
Verify all displayed metrics and charts reflect current system data accurately.

title: Compliance with LGPD Data Protection Standards
description: Validate that the system handles data in compliance with LGPD, including data storage, user consent, and audit logging.

steps.description: Access patient data editing interface.
Modify personal data requiring consent.
Verify system prompts for explicit user consent before saving changes.
Request data export to test data subject's right of access.
Verify exported data is complete, accurate, and formatted per LGPD requirements.
Review audit logs after data access and modification.
Verify all actions are logged with user identification and timestamps.

title: Inventory Management - Stock Alerts and Movement History
description: Verify inventory system generates alerts for low stock and maintains accurate item movement history.

steps.description: Reduce stock quantity of a clinical supply below alert threshold.
Verify system issues a low stock alert notification.
Add stock to inventory for same item.
Verify stock movement is recorded in history with correct details.
Review stock movement history for specific item.
Verify history entries are accurate and chronologically ordered.

title: Task Management - Prioritization and Notifications
description: Verify tasks can be prioritized, tracked, and trigger notifications on due dates or status changes.

steps.description: Create tasks with varying priorities.
Verify tasks are listed and ordered according to priority.
Change task status to completed.
Verify completion triggers notification to assigned user.
Set a task with a due date shortly in the future.
Wait for due date to trigger notification.
Verify notification is received on time.

title: Teleconsulta - Video Call Connection and Session Recording
description: Verify teleconsultation video calls connect properly, support user controls, and session recording functions.

steps.description: Initiate a video call between therapist and patient.
Verify video and audio streams establish correctly with low latency.
Use controls to mute, pause video, and share screen.
Verify controls function as expected without disconnection.
Start session recording.
End session and save recording.
Verify session recording is saved and accessible in history logs.

title: Exercise Library - Multimedia Content and Personalization
description: Verify exercise library displays categorized multimedia content and supports personalized exercise prescriptions.

steps.description: Access exercise library and browse by specialty category.
Verify correct multimedia content (images, video, descriptions) is displayed per exercise.
Select exercises to create a personalized prescription for a patient.
Verify personalized prescription is saved and linked correctly to patient records.
